costCompleteShare.description: Last decisions with a complete estimate / last decisions of the day.

costPerUnitCents.description: Sum of estimatedCostCents / sum of units over the complete last decisions; null when undefined.

p50CostCentsPerGroup.description: Median estimatedCostCents per group over the complete last decisions; null without one.

p90CostCentsPerGroup.description: 90th-percentile estimatedCostCents per group over the complete last decisions; null without one.

400.description: invalid-report-range. from or to is not a date (YYYY-MM-DD), from is after to, or the range exceeds 366 days.

type.description: Problem type URI: the base https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/ followed by the slug, for example https://errors.order-sourcing.retail-network.example/assignment-locked.

500.description: internal-error, an unexpected failure (the detail never carries the internal message).
